hypotheses.explanation: Cartservice repeatedly reports it cannot connect to redis-cart and Redis operations time out; traces show failed Redis calls preceding cart and checkout errors.
Requests from cartservice to redis-cart repeatedly take roughly 5.7–6 seconds and time out while waiting for a connection, consistent with a slow or unreachable service edge.

GetCart repeatedly returns errors after long durations, and cartservice logs FailedPrecondition when cart storage cannot be accessed; successful GetCart metric data also exists, so this appears less likely as an independent cause.
